desiredBehavior: Preserve desired outcomes and rejection reasons; replacing a rejected decision needs explicit supersession from the operator.

mechanism.rationale: A pre-effect lineage guard compares explicit decisions; a text lint cannot decide which prior rejection applies.

mechanism.rationale: A pure event reactor computes the monotone policy transition; a static guard cannot remember the correction across later effects.

mechanism.rationale: A deterministic footer/trailer predicate is sufficient; invocation settings reduce generation and the commit hook checks actual bytes.

incident.summary: The implementer discipline requires reading the produced diff before reporting completion.

mechanism.rationale: A handoff gate compares read receipts and current content identities; prose cannot witness that the bytes were delivered.

incident.summary: The recorded Boy Scout policy admits only unambiguous adjacent cleanup covered by the same verification; the operator's artifact-growth clarification also rejects cleanup without a demonstrated problem.

mechanism.rationale: A pre-effect gate checks a scoped host-reviewed assessment; scripts alone cannot establish semantic adjacency or risk.
